question: Why can student not delete Substitutions (403) in UntisX (endpoint /grades)?
answer: Check role student. Module Substitutions may require higher permissions. Error 403: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /grades and the database connection. Feature Substitutions must be enabled.
